hooks.text: 先用房间与走廊卡亲手扩建迷宫，再自动闯过自己造出的地牢
hooks.excerpt: Use your deck of cards, representing rooms and corridors, to grow the labyrinth of the ruins. Then auto-battle your way through them, harvesting as much Glimour as you can from the cursed residents before darkness overcomes your torch.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 把篝火、图书馆与传送门按位置组合，触发房间之间的战略协同
hooks.excerpt: Strategic Room Synergies: Place rooms like campfires, libraries, and portals strategically to unlock powerful effects and adapt your approach to every challenge.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 以苏格兰民俗中的女巫、精灵和丰收少女构建遗迹世界，并可用盖尔语游玩
hooks.excerpt: Rooted in Scottish Folklore : Explore a world inspired by Celtic legends, from witches and faeries to the eerie Maiden and her connection to the Harvests, with the option to immerse yourself in the experience by playing in Scottish Gaelic.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
